attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the accounts.
description: A user account attempted to authenticate to a target using NTLM an excessive number of times in a short period. This may indicate an NTLM brute force attack.
investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
name: NTLM Brute Force

variations.name: NTLM brute force on a sensitive user
variations.description: A user account attempted to authenticate to a target using NTLM an excessive number of times in a short period on a sensitive account. This may indicate an NTLM brute force attack.
variations.attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the accounts.
variations.investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.

variations.name: High-frequency NTLM brute force attempts detected
variations.description: A user account attempted to authenticate to a target using NTLM an excessive number of times and with high frequency. This may indicate an NTLM brute force attack.
variations.attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the accounts.
variations.investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
